newsitem.title: USA: Ruddick's Harris Teeter unit Q1 sales rises.
newsitem.headline: Ruddick's Harris Teeter unit Q1 sales rises.

text.p: Harris Teeter Inc, the operating unit of Ruddick Corp, said Monday that based on unaudited results, sales for the first quarter ending December 31 were up 5.2 percent to $486.7 million from $462.6 million in the comparable quarter a year ago.
It said same-store sales for the latest quarter were up 2.5 percent. As of December 31, it said it operated 133 stores, compared with 138 in the previous year.
Harris Teeter operates 133 supermarkets in North and South Carolina, Virginia, Georgia, and Tennessee.
Ruddick also operates American & Efird Inc, a maker of industrial sewing thread.
